portfolioCases.title: Cross-Border B2B Campaign Pacing & Resource Forecasting Engine
portfolioCases.clientOrContext: G9 Outsourcing Corp. / inCall Systems Pte. Ltd. (Singapore & Philippines)
portfolioCases.summary: Designed dynamic Excel pacing models balancing distributed agent man-days against aggressive attendee registration quotas for global enterprise IT accounts.
portfolioCases.problem: International B2B event registration campaigns faced volatile daily turnout. Without predictive man-day pacing, campaigns experienced end-of-cycle resource deficits, missed RSVP quotas, and uneven lead distribution across remote Singapore and onsite Philippine teams.
portfolioCases.objective: Build a centralized daily forecasting and milestone tracking system to maintain SLA compliance, optimize man-day utilization across low-traction periods, and ensure on-time delivery of 150–500 attendee targets.
portfolioCases.myRole: Operations Team Leader (sole architect of the daily pacing model, production standup facilitator, and agent allocator).
approach: Constructed a multi-variable Excel production model tracking target attendees, cumulative dials, contact rates, conversion ratios, and remaining man-days.
Implemented pacing variance formulas that automatically recalculated daily call quotas whenever low-traction days (holidays, regional events) occurred.
Standardized morning 9:30 AM briefings to review real-time pacing, reallocate call lists in the CRM, and deploy targeted objection handling scripts.
deliverables: Dynamic Excel Campaign Milestone & Man-Day Pacing Tracker.
Daily 9:30 AM Production Briefing Deck & Agent Quota Allocation Schedule.
Cross-Border CRM List Distribution Playbook (Singapore remote + PH onsite).
portfolioCases.outcome: Successfully managed 15 concurrent campaigns. Hit benchmark targets including delivering 106 verified attendees within 56 allocated man-days for high-profile IT enterprise event portfolios.

portfolioCases.title: Executive Inbox Operating System & DRRN Decision Engine
portfolioCases.clientOrContext: Athena / Oraz PH Candidate Preparation (Case CP-ALEXANDRA-REYES-INBOX)
portfolioCases.summary: Engineered an asynchronous Executive Inbox Operating System combining high-context triage, VIP filtering, and DRRN decision logic to protect executive deep work.
portfolioCases.problem: High-growth executives face cognitive overload from 30+ daily mixed-urgency emails, conflicting calendar demands, and uncoordinated stakeholder requests that encroach on critical strategic blocks.
portfolioCases.objective: Design an airtight Inbox Operating System (IOS) that categorizes, delegates, and resolves incoming correspondence while delivering a concise (<3 min read) executive morning brief.
portfolioCases.myRole: Executive Assistant Execution Partner (lead author and triage architect).
approach: Created an Inbox Prioritization Matrix categorizing correspondence by Priority (Critical, High, Medium, Low) and Action (Review, Delegate, Track, Archive).
Formulated the DRRN Framework (Decision/Recommendation, Reason, Risk/Trade-off, Next Step/Mitigation) for all high-stakes trade-offs.
Drafted an Executive Morning Brief featuring BLUF, Top 3 Immediate Priorities, Delegated Work, and Watch Items, while protecting 8:30 AM – 12:00 PM deep work blocks.
deliverables: 30-Item Inbox Prioritization Matrix with concrete routing rules.
Standardized Executive Morning Brief Template (<3 min read).
Inbox Operating System Architecture (VIP Stakeholder Directory, Archive Rules, Daily Operating Cadence).
portfolioCases.outcome: Demonstrated complete attention defense: eliminated urgent interruptions during protected deep work, redirected media inquiries per firm policy, and staged legal sign-offs for zero-friction execution.
portfolioCases.evidenceType: Athena / Oraz PH Candidate Preparation Case Study (CP-ALEXANDRA-REYES-INBOX)

portfolioCases.title: Distributed Team Operating Rhythm & Quality Governance Cadence
portfolioCases.clientOrContext: G9 Outsourcing Corp. (Singapore Remote & Philippine Onsite Teams)
portfolioCases.summary: Established standardized operational cadences, quality benchmarks, and recording governance across 5 remote Singapore agents and 5–20 Philippine onsite staff.
portfolioCases.problem: Geographically dispersed telemarketing and outreach agents operated with fragmented communications, resulting in inconsistent script adherence, unrecorded calls, and delayed escalations.
portfolioCases.objective: Create a unified operational cadence and documentation repository ensuring complete auditability, synchronized daily objectives, and continuous coaching.
portfolioCases.myRole: Operations Team Leader (operational conductor and quality coach).
approach: Instituted mandatory daily 9:30 AM production briefings to align cross-border agents on daily focus areas, enterprise client nuances, and script adaptations.
Established SharePoint governance protocols requiring all client call recordings and outreach logs to be indexed and audited within 24 hours.
Applied Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt root-cause analysis on call conversion drops, updating call plans and coaching agents on specific objection patterns.
deliverables: Standardized 9:30 AM Briefing Agenda & Production Checklist.
SharePoint Audio & Call Record Governance Structure.
Agent Onboarding & Script Refinement Guide for Enterprise IT Outreach.
portfolioCases.outcome: Maintained continuous SLA compliance across 10 registration and 5 lead-gen campaigns with zero data loss or unrecorded interactions, improving agent ramp time and client audit readiness.

Contractor Payroll Calculation Spreadsheet with verification checks.
